a.lede: Uber's Lucid-made robotaxis, powered by Nuro, are almost ready to give rides to the public.
a.title: Uber and Lucid start testing fully driverless rides for their robotaxis in San Francisco

b.lede: Uber and Nuro have started testing driverless Lucid Gravity SUVs on public streets in the San Francisco Bay Area.
b.title: Uber and Nuro begin driverless testing of Lucid robotaxis ahead of 2027 launch
